cap_ClWeek.text:
Capabilities: week-grid, two-time-zones, work-package-bars, meeting-work-package-chip, context-panel, drag-to-change-dates.
What you see: The week of 12 to 18 October in the calm grid: CEST and UTC columns, soft meetings, a faded past event, Thursday's rollout review dashed because it is not answered yet, BUG #58231 with grab handles in the all-day strip, and the context panel with the next meeting, this week's due work packages and the shortcuts.

cap_ClEvent.text:
Capabilities: event-panel, mail-origin, accept-maybe-decline, linked-work-package, log-time.
What you see: The Thursday rollout review selected. The navigation folds to the rail and the right column shows the event: time, Join, the attendees, the mail the invitation came from, Accept as the one green action, FEATURE #58412 and Log time on this work package with 1 h filled in.

cap_ClMonth.text:
Capabilities: month-grid, work-package-bars, milestone, new-from-empty-day, context-panel.
What you see: October 2026 into November with plain day numbers and today in a filled badge. EPIC #57990 and FEATURE #58412 span their weeks as soft bars, the Go-live Lyon milestone is a diamond on 2 November, and the hovered 28 October offers New meeting and New work package.

cap_ClPlan.text:
Capabilities: work-package-list, grouped-by-status, assigned-to-me-filter, drag-to-block-time, linked-time-block.
What you see: The week with the work package list open beside the grid, grouped by status. TASK #58455 is lifted over Tuesday with a dashed target block from 14:00 to 16:00 and the hint Drop to block time for this work package.

cap_ClLinkWorkPackage.text:
Capabilities: work-package-picker, suggestions-by-reason, event-link-scope, repeating-event-scope, comment-in-activity, work-package-from-event.
What you see: Level 2, act. The navigation folded to the rail, Tuesday's Demo preparation Malmo Energi selected in the week, and on the right a 440 px panel Link to work package with the same picker as in mail: the field empty and the suggestions In this event, Same people and Recent. Under it the scope This event or This and following events, one checkbox to post a comment, the green Link and New work package from this event.
